grammar.purpose: Identify whether an exception or addition is intended
grammar.explanation: 除了 introduces a noun phrase or activity. Its interpretation depends on the following clause: 除了我，大家都来 excludes me; 除了看节目，我还听广播 adds an activity. 以外 can follow the phrase. The same 除了 phrase without its continuation does not decide the meaning by itself.

examples.py: chú le wǒ , dà jiā dōu lái le .

examples.zh: 除了看节目，我还听广播。
examples.py: chú le kàn jié mù , wǒ hái tīng guǎng bō .
examples.en: Besides watching programmes, I also listen to the radio.

examples.zh: 除了周末以外，她晚上也有空。
examples.py: chú le zhōu mò yǐ wài , tā wǎn shang yě yǒu kōng .
examples.en: Besides weekends, she is also free in the evenings.

commonMistakes.wrong: 除了我，大家都来，所以我也来。
commonMistakes.right: 除了我，大家都来，我不来。
commonMistakes.why: In this 都 construction, the named person is excluded.

grammar.pattern: 除了……（以外），还 / 也 / 都……
grammar.purpose: Read the continuation and its scope
grammar.explanation: 还/也 commonly signal addition: 除了电视节目，她也看网上的视频. 都 commonly totals the remaining group after an exception: 除了我，大家都看过. State the remainder rather than treating 都 as a claim about all people everywhere. Do not infer whether another person joins from their preference for a similar activity.

examples.zh: 除了广播，我还看电视节目。
examples.py: chú le guǎng bō , wǒ hái kàn diàn shì jié mù .
examples.en: Besides the radio, I also watch TV programmes.

examples.zh: 除了她以外，我也没看过。
examples.py: chú le tā yǐ wài , wǒ yě méi kàn guò .
examples.en: Besides her, I too have not watched it.

examples.zh: 除了周五，其他几天都可以。
examples.py: chú le zhōu wǔ , qí tā jǐ tiān dōu kě yǐ .
examples.en: Any of the other days works, except Friday.

commonMistakes.wrong: 除了我，大家都看过，所以所有人都看过。
commonMistakes.why: The total applies to the remaining group, not the excluded member.

lines.zh: 除了我，你们都看过这个节目了？
lines.py: chú le wǒ , nǐ men dōu kàn guò zhè gè jié mù le ?
lines.en: Has everyone seen this show except me?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我也没看完，只看了开头。
lines.py: wǒ yě méi kàn wán , zhǐ kàn le kāi tóu .
lines.en: I haven't finished either. I've only seen the beginning.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那你干吗说最后一集最好？
lines.py: nà nǐ gàn má shuō zuì hòu yī jí zuì hǎo ?
lines.en: Then why did you say the last episode was the best?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我听姐姐说的。她一边看一边哭，纸都用完了。
lines.py: wǒ tīng jiě jie shuō de . tā yī biān kàn yī biān kū , zhǐ dōu yòng wán le .
lines.en: My sister told me. She cried so much watching it that she used up the tissues.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这么动人？我还以为是那种一直让人笑的节目。
lines.py: zhè me dòng rén ? wǒ hái yǐ wéi shì nà zhǒng yì zhí ràng rén xiào de jié mù .
lines.en: Is it that moving? I thought it was the kind that keeps you laughing.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 开头是很好笑。后面怎么样，我真不知道。
lines.py: kāi tóu shì hěn hǎo xiào . hòu miàn zěn me yàng , wǒ zhēn bù zhī dào .
lines.en: The beginning is funny. I honestly don't know about the rest.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 今晚电视台还播吗？
lines.py: jīn wǎn diàn shì tái hái bō ma ?
lines.en: Is the TV station showing it again tonight?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 八点重播第一集。你要来我家一起看吗？
lines.py: bā diǎn chóng bō dì yī jí . nǐ yào lái wǒ jiā yì qǐ kàn ma ?
lines.en: The first episode is repeated at eight. Want to watch at my place?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 来。除了看节目，我们还可以点个晚饭。
lines.py: lái . chú le kàn jié mù , wǒ men hái kě yǐ diǎn gè wǎn fàn .
lines.en: Yes. Besides watching, we can order dinner.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，但你别看到一半就问最后谁回来了。
lines.py: hǎo , dàn nǐ bié kàn dào yí bàn jiù wèn zuì hòu shéi huí lái le .
lines.en: Fine, but don't ask who returns at the end halfway through.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你不是也不知道吗？
lines.py: nǐ bù shì yě bù zhī dào ma ?
lines.en: You don't know either, do you?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 所以别问，我也想知道。
lines.py: suǒ yǐ bié wèn , wǒ yě xiǎng zhī dào .
lines.en: Exactly. Don't ask; I want to find out too.
lines.speaker: b

choices: Watch episode one together and order dinner
Ask the sister to tell every detail

reading.title: A broad audience is not one habit
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 最近朋友们都在聊一个电视节目。我没看过，听他们说最后一集时，总觉得自己少认识了几个朋友。
lines.py: zuì jìn péng you men dōu zài liáo yī gè diàn shì jié mù . wǒ méi kàn guò , tīng tā men shuō zuì hòu yī jí shí , zǒng jué de zì jǐ shǎo rèn shi le jǐ gè péng you .
lines.en: My friends have been talking about a TV show. When they discussed its last episode, I felt as if there were a few friends I had yet to meet.

lines.zh: 陈宇说除了看最后一集，还得从第一集开始。我问他是不是全看完了，他承认只看了开头，后面的情节都是姐姐告诉他的。
lines.py: chén yǔ shuō chú le kàn zuì hòu yī jí , hái děi cóng dì yī jí kāi shǐ . wǒ wèn tā shì bú shì quán kàn wán le , tā chéng rèn zhǐ kàn le kāi tóu , hòu miàn de qíng jié dōu shì jiě jie gào sù tā de .
lines.en: Chen Yu said I needed the first episode as well as the last. When I asked if he had finished it, he admitted he had only seen the beginning. His sister had told him the rest.

lines.zh: 我们在互联网上查到电视台晚上八点重播第一集。我下班后带了晚饭去他家，两个人先吃，再打开电视。
lines.py: wǒ men zài hù lián wǎng shàng chá dào diàn shì tái wǎn shang bā diǎn chóng bō dì yī jí . wǒ xià bān hòu dài le wǎn fàn qù tā jiā , liǎng gè rén xiān chī , zài dǎ kāi diàn shì .
lines.en: Online we found that the station repeated episode one at eight. I took dinner to his place after work. We ate before turning on the TV.

lines.zh: 节目开头很好笑，陈宇总看我有没有笑。我说你也看屏幕，别把我当观众里的唯一一个人。
lines.py: jié mù kāi tóu hěn hǎo xiào , chén yǔ zǒng kàn wǒ yǒu méi yǒu xiào . wǒ shuō nǐ yě kàn píng mù , bié bǎ wǒ dāng guān zhòng lǐ de wéi yī yī gè rén .
lines.en: The opening was funny. Chen Yu kept checking my reaction. I told him to watch the screen too, instead of treating me as the only person in the audience.

lines.zh: 看到最后，门外响起一个人的声音，可画面没有拍到是谁。我们都想再看一集，明天却还要上班，只好先关掉。
lines.py: kàn dào zuì hòu , mén wài xiǎng qǐ yī gè rén de shēng yīn , kě huà miàn méi yǒu pāi dào shì shéi . wǒ men dōu xiǎng zài kàn yī jí , míng tiān què hái yào shàng bān , zhǐ hǎo xiān guān diào .
lines.en: At the end someone spoke outside the door, but the camera did not show who. We both wanted another episode, but work the next day meant switching off.

lines.zh: 回家以后，我给他发消息说除了周五晚上，其他晚上都能再看。他马上回，周四吧，我也想知道门外是谁。
lines.py: huí jiā yǐ hòu , wǒ gěi tā fā xiāo xī shuō chú le zhōu wǔ wǎn shang , qí tā wǎn shang dōu néng zài kàn . tā mǎ shàng huí , zhōu sì ba , wǒ yě xiǎng zhī dào mén wài shì shéi .
lines.en: Back home I messaged that any evening except Friday worked for another episode. He immediately suggested Thursday: he wanted to know who was outside too.

choices: Catching up on a show friends discuss

choices: They do not choose an evening
They have work the next day

lines.zh: 除了看电影，我还喜欢画画。
lines.py: chú le kàn diàn yǐng , wǒ hái xǐ huān huà huà .
lines.en: Besides watching films, I like drawing.

lines.zh: 手机支付已经很普遍了。
lines.py: shǒu jī zhī fù yǐ jīng hěn pǔ biàn le .
lines.en: Paying by phone is widespread now.

lines.zh: 这类问题在刚开始的时候很普遍。
lines.py: zhè lèi wèn tí zài gāng kāi shǐ de shí hou hěn pǔ biàn .
lines.en: This kind of problem is common at the beginning.

lines.zh: 你喜欢哪一类电影？
lines.py: nǐ xǐ huān nǎ yī lèi diàn yǐng ?
lines.en: What kind of films do you like?

lines.zh: 这两类书放在不同的书架上。
lines.py: zhè liǎng lèi shū fàng zài bù tóng de shū jià shàng .
lines.en: These two types of books go on different shelves.

lines.zh: 我昨天也遇到过类似的问题。
lines.py: wǒ zuó tiān yě yù dào guò lèi sì de wèn tí .
lines.en: I had a similar problem yesterday.

lines.zh: 这道菜和我妈妈做的很类似。
lines.py: zhè dào cài hé wǒ mā mā zuò de hěn lèi sì .
lines.en: This dish is similar to my mother's version.

lines.zh: 这两个词有什么区别？
lines.py: zhè liǎng gè cí yǒu shén me qū bié ?
lines.en: What's the difference between these words?

lines.zh: 我尝不出两种茶的区别。
lines.py: wǒ cháng bù chū liǎng zhǒng chá de qū bié .
lines.en: I can't taste the difference between these teas.

lines.zh: 这座房屋具有古代建筑的特色。
lines.py: zhè zuò fáng wū jù yǒu gǔ dài jiàn zhù de tè sè .
lines.en: This house has features of ancient architecture.

lines.zh: 这种材料具有一定的保温作用。
lines.py: zhè zhǒng cái liào jù yǒu yí dìng de bǎo wēn zuò yòng .
lines.en: This material has some insulating properties.

lines.zh: 她把人生中的重要时刻写成了一本书。
lines.py: tā bǎ rén shēng zhōng de zhòng yào shí kè xiě chéng le yī běn shū .
lines.en: She wrote a book about important moments in her life.

lines.zh: 他在朋友的帮助下开始了新的人生。
lines.py: tā zài péng you de bāng zhù xià kāi shǐ le xīn de rén shēng .
lines.en: With friends' help, he began a new life.

lines.zh: 音乐响起，全场都安静了。
lines.py: yīn yuè xiǎng qǐ , quán chǎng dōu ān jìng le .
lines.en: When the music began, the whole room fell quiet.

lines.zh: 他一上台，全场就笑了。
lines.py: tā yī shàng tái , quán chǎng jiù xiào le .
lines.en: The whole audience laughed as soon as he came on stage.

lines.zh: 观众在门外排队。
lines.py: guān zhòng zài mén wài pái duì .
lines.en: The audience is queuing outside.

lines.zh: 表演结束后，观众站起来鼓掌。
lines.py: biǎo yǎn jié shù hòu , guān zhòng zhàn qǐ lái gǔ zhǎng .
lines.en: After the performance the audience stood and applauded.

lines.zh: 我们准备一起观看决赛。
lines.py: wǒ men zhǔn bèi yì qǐ guān kàn jué sài .
lines.en: We're going to watch the final together.

lines.zh: 这段视频可以反复观看。
lines.py: zhè duàn shì pín kě yǐ fǎn fù guān kàn .
lines.en: This video can be watched repeatedly.

lines.zh: 她每天晚上收看新闻。
lines.py: tā měi tiān wǎn shang shōu kàn xīn wén .
lines.en: She watches the news every evening.

lines.zh: 欢迎收看今天的节目。
lines.py: huān yíng shōu kàn jīn tiān de jié mù .
lines.en: Welcome to today's programme.

lines.zh: 我爸爸开车时收听广播。
lines.py: wǒ bà bà kāi chē shí shōu tīng guǎng bō .
lines.en: My father listens to the radio while driving.

lines.zh: 感谢大家收听，下周再见。
lines.py: gǎn xiè dà jiā shōu tīng , xià zhōu zài jiàn .
lines.en: Thanks for listening. See you next week.

lines.zh: 有位听众打电话来点歌。
lines.py: yǒu wèi tīng zhòng dǎ diàn huà lái diǎn gē .
lines.en: A listener called to request a song.

lines.zh: 主持人读了听众寄来的信。
lines.py: zhǔ chí rén dú le tīng zhòng jì lái de xìn .
lines.en: The host read a listener's letter.

lines.zh: 我在广播里听到了这首歌。
lines.py: wǒ zài guǎng bō lǐ tīng dào le zhè shǒu gē .
lines.en: I heard this song on the radio.

lines.zh: 车站广播通知旅客换站台。
lines.py: chē zhàn guǎng bō tōng zhī lǚ kè huàn zhàn tái .
lines.en: The station announcement told passengers to change platforms.

lines.zh: 这家电台每天早上七点播新闻。
lines.py: zhè jiā diàn tái měi tiān zǎo shàng qī diǎn bō xīn wén .
lines.en: This station broadcasts news at seven each morning.

lines.zh: 她想去电台工作。
lines.py: tā xiǎng qù diàn tái gōng zuò .
lines.en: She wants to work at a radio station.

lines.zh: 电视台今天来学校拍节目。
lines.py: diàn shì tái jīn tiān lái xué xiào pāi jié mù .
lines.en: The TV station is filming at the school today.

lines.zh: 我姐姐在电视台工作。
lines.py: wǒ jiě jie zài diàn shì tái gōng zuò .
lines.en: My sister works at a TV station.

lines.zh: 这个节目在国内很受欢迎。
lines.py: zhè gè jié mù zài guó nèi hěn shòu huān yíng .
lines.en: This show is popular within the country.

lines.zh: 他先在国内旅行，后来去了国外。
lines.py: tā xiān zài guó nèi lǚ xíng , hòu lái qù le guó wài .
lines.en: He travelled domestically before going abroad.

lines.zh: 比赛吸引了全球的观众。
lines.py: bǐ sài xī yǐn le quán qiú de guān zhòng .
lines.en: The match attracted viewers around the world.

lines.zh: 这家公司的产品销往全球。
lines.py: zhè jiā gōng sī de chǎn pǐn xiāo wǎng quán qiú .
lines.en: This company's products are sold worldwide.

lines.zh: 这封信感谢了广大读者。
lines.py: zhè fēng xìn gǎn xiè le guǎng dà dú zhě .
lines.en: The letter thanked the many readers.

lines.zh: 活动欢迎广大市民参加。
lines.py: huó dòng huān yíng guǎng dà shì mín cān jiā .
lines.en: The event welcomes the public to take part.

lines.zh: 几家媒体报道了这场比赛。
lines.py: jǐ jiā méi tǐ bào dào le zhè chǎng bǐ sài .
lines.en: Several media outlets covered the match.

lines.zh: 她在媒体上看到这条消息。
lines.py: tā zài méi tǐ shàng kàn dào zhè tiáo xiāo xī .
lines.en: She saw this news in the media.

lines.zh: 我通过互联网和家人联系。
lines.py: wǒ tōng guò hù lián wǎng hé jiā rén lián xì .
lines.en: I keep in touch with family over the internet.

lines.zh: 这家小店也在互联网上卖东西。
lines.py: zhè jiā xiǎo diàn yě zài hù lián wǎng shàng mài dōng xi .
lines.en: This little shop also sells online.

lines.zh: 两所学校联合举办了比赛。
lines.py: liǎng suǒ xué xiào lián hé jǔ bàn le bǐ sài .
lines.en: Two schools jointly held the competition.

lines.zh: 他们联合起来解决了这个问题。
lines.py: tā men lián hé qǐ lái jiě jué le zhè gè wèn tí .
lines.en: They joined forces to solve the problem.

audio.zh: 八点重播第一集。你要来我家一起看吗？
audio.py: bā diǎn chóng bō dì yī jí . nǐ yào lái wǒ jiā yì qǐ kàn ma ?
audio.en: The first episode is repeated at eight. Want to watch at my place?

tasks.statement: Episode one is repeated at eight.
tasks.why: The line explicitly states this detail.

audio.zh: 回家以后，我给他发消息说除了周五晚上，其他晚上都能再看。他马上回，周四吧，我也想知道门外是谁。
audio.py: huí jiā yǐ hòu , wǒ gěi tā fā xiāo xī shuō chú le zhōu wǔ wǎn shang , qí tā wǎn shang dōu néng zài kàn . tā mǎ shàng huí , zhōu sì ba , wǒ yě xiǎng zhī dào mén wài shì shéi .
audio.en: Back home I messaged that any evening except Friday worked for another episode. He immediately suggested Thursday: he wanted to know who was outside too.

tasks.statement: The next meeting is on Friday.
tasks.why: The passage gives a different outcome.

prompt.en: Friday does not work. Watch together on Thursday?

notes:
AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 三28, 三38. Native check: 普遍 versus universal scope, 除了…也 negation, 收看/观看 and 收听 register, 广大 audience collocation, and the original verse’s ellipsis. No population survey is claimed. Native review pending. Planned retrieval 三23 / 三40 / 三26 / 三72: 我为她担心，也尊重她的选择。, 对我来说，安静很重要。, 为了带书方便，我选这个布袋。, 为了纪念见面，我们做一张贺卡。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Earlier HSK 3 naturalness correction: delivery and a wet bag; two friends catching up on a show; noodles with chilli served separately; friends admitting date mistakes. Corrected quilt/chair continuity: trousers move to the other chair, the old quilt joins them, and both are removed before the seat is free. Formal vocabulary uses independent contexts rather than speech that sounds like a report. Replaced abstract caution and assessment-policy dialogue. All target words get two independently authored contexts, and old word/task/unit IDs remain intact. Native flags: colloquial passive 叫, 具有 with formal collocations, 广大 in public notices, the playful eating invitation, 活 as vivid portrayal and 乐 lè as laughter. All distractors and true/false keys were checked against the rewritten facts. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
